\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \frac{n}{\displaystyle\sum_{(s,t) \in S_{xy}} \frac{1}{I(s,t)}}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(S_{xy}\): The window around pixel (x, y)
- \(n\): Number of values in the window

n divided by the sum of the inverses of the window values. Small values have large inverses, so they dominate, and a bright speck has little effect. If any value is 0, its inverse is infinite and the output is 0.
